assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches the first law of thermodynamics (ΔU = Q - W), a physics concept. G9-L-6 requires classifying Philippine animals and plants as critically endangered, endangered, or vulnerable. There is no connection to biodiversity or species classification.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The first law of thermodynamics
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to research how to protect and conserve endangered and/or economically important species in the local community
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about thermodynamics, not about protecting or conserving endangered or economically important species. G9-L-8 is a living-things conservation competency, completely unrelated to the card content.

copy.en: The first law of thermodynamics states that the change in internal energy of a system equals the net heat added to the system minus the net work done by the system, written as ΔU = Q - W.
copy.tl: Sinasabi ng first law of thermodynamics na ang pagbabago sa internal energy ng isang system ay katumbas ng net heat na idinagdag sa system minus ang net work na ginawa ng system, na isinusulat bilang ΔU = Q - W.
copy.bis: Ang first law of thermodynamics nag-ingon nga ang pagbag-o sa internal energy sa usa ka system katumbas sa net heat nga gidugang sa system minus ang net work nga gihimo sa system, gisulat isip ΔU = Q - W.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: first menstrual bleeding
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the outer body parts of animals, such as head, legs or wings, and identify their role to move and to gather food
assignedReviews.reason: The competency G3-L-4 requires observing and describing the outer body parts of animals (head, legs, wings) and their roles in movement and food gathering. The card is about menarche, a human female reproductive milestone, which is unrelated to animal outer body parts or their functions.

copy.en:
What is the first menstrual bleeding called?

It is called menarche, and it signals that a girl's body is now able to become pregnant.
copy.tl:
Ano ang tawag sa unang pagdurugo ng regla?

Ito ay tinatawag na menarche, at hudyat ito na kaya nang mabuntis ang katawan ng babae.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang tawag sa unang pagdugo sa regla?

Kini gitawag og menarche, ug signal kini nga makaya na sa lawas sa babaye nga magmabdos.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Some nets first surround a school of fish like a fence, then close the bottom shut so the fish cannot escape downward!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided activities to demonstrate that pushes and pulls can be used to change the speed and direction of an object including making it go faster, turn it to a different direction, slow it down, and stop it
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a fishing net technique (surrounding and closing a school of fish). It does not discuss pushes or pulls changing the speed or direction of an object, nor any force-related concept. The content is unrelated to the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Some nets first surround a school of fish like a fence, then close the bottom shut so the fish cannot escape downward!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and demonstrate different ways to make objects move by natural causes, such as wind and water, or by people, such as pushing, pulling, rolling, and carrying
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about a net surrounding fish, not about ways to make objects move by natural causes or by people (pushing, pulling, rolling, carrying). No movement of objects is described; the net's action is not framed as a force or motion demonstration.

copy.en: Some nets first surround a school of fish like a fence, then close the bottom shut so the fish cannot escape downward!
copy.tl: May lambat na pinapalibutan muna ang isang kawan ng isda na parang kural, pagkatapos ay isinasara ang ilalim para hindi makatakas pababa ang mga isda!
copy.bis: Adunay pukot nga libutan una ang panon sa isda nga murag koral, dayon sirhan ang ubos niini aron dili makaikyas paubos ang mga isda!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: After five half-lives, only 3.125 percent of the original radioactive parent remains.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate through guided investigation the advantages and limitations of simple machines, such as inclined planes, wedges, levers, and pulleys
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about radioactive decay and half-lives (absolute dating), with no content on simple machines, their advantages, or limitations.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: After five half-lives, only 3.125 percent of the original radioactive parent remains.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: carry out fair tests to show how levers can be used to change the magnitude and direction of a force
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not address levers, fair tests, or changing the magnitude and direction of a force; it is entirely about radioactive half-life calculations.

copy.en: After five half-lives, only 3.125 percent of the original radioactive parent remains.
copy.tl: Pagkatapos ng limang half-life, 3.125 porsyento na lamang ng orihinal na radioactive parent ang natitira.
copy.bis: Human sa lima ka half-life, 3.125 porsyento na lamang sa orihinal nga radioactive parent ang nahibilin.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: There's a small spot at the back of your eye with no sensors
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the eye's blind spot, which is not one of the human body systems listed in the competency (muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, respiratory). It provides no information about any of those systems.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: There's a small spot at the back of your eye with no sensors
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the characteristics of living things: they grow, respond, and reproduce
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about vision and the blind spot, not about the characteristics of living things (grow, respond, reproduce). It does not support this competency.

copy.en:
Does your eye really see everything?

Not quite! There's a small spot at the back of your eye with no sensors, so everyone has a 'blind spot.' Your brain fills in the gap so you never notice it.
copy.tl:
Nakikita ba talaga ng mata ang lahat?

Hindi pala! May maliit na bahagi sa likod ng mata na walang sensor, kaya may 'blind spot' tayo. Pinupunan ito ng utak kaya hindi natin ito napapansin.
copy.bis:
Makita ba jud sa mata ang tanan?

Dili diay! Adunay gamay nga bahin sa luyo sa mata nga walay sensor, mao nga aduna tay 'blind spot.' Pun-an kini sa utok mao nga wala nato kini mamatikdi.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The dry season is best because there is no rain
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain what volcanoes are and how they are formed
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the best time to repair roofs, relating to dry season weather, and has no content about volcanoes or their formation. It does not support the competency in any way.

copy.en:
When is the best time to fix a damaged roof or ceiling?

The dry season is best because there is no rain, so workers can repair leaks safely and the materials stay dry.
copy.tl:
Kailan ang pinakamainam na panahon para ayusin ang sirang bubong o kisame?

Ang dry season ang pinakamainam dahil walang ulan, kaya ligtas na makakapag-ayos ang mga manggagawa at mananatiling tuyo ang mga materyales.
copy.bis:
Kanus-a ang labing maayo nga panahon sa pag-ayo sa guba nga atop o kisame?

Ang dry season ang labing maayo kay walay ulan, busa luwas nga makaayo ang mga trabahador ug magpabiling uga ang mga materyales.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The flank is the side of a volcano, while the summit is its highest point
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided activities to carefully observe and describe the natural objects commonly seen in the sky during daytime and nighttime, including the Sun, the Moon, planets, and stars
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes volcano anatomy (flank and summit), which is unrelated to observing natural objects in the sky such as the Sun, Moon, planets, and stars. The competency is about celestial objects, not volcanic features.

copy.en: The flank is the side of a volcano, while the summit is its highest point, also called the apex.
copy.tl: Ang flank ay ang gilid ng isang volcano, habang ang summit naman ang pinakamataas na bahagi nito, na tinatawag ding apex.
copy.bis: Ang flank mao ang kilid sa usa ka volcano, samtang ang summit mao ang kinatas-ang parte, nga gitawag usab ug apex.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Place a graduated cylinder on a flat surface
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how relative and absolute dating techniques are used to determine the subdivisions of geologic time
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches proper technique for reading a graduated cylinder (volume measurement). G9-E-5 is about relative and absolute dating techniques for geologic time subdivisions. There is no connection between the card content and the competency.

copy.en: Place a graduated cylinder on a flat surface before reading the volume, because holding it can tilt it and give a wrong measurement.
copy.tl: Ilagay ang graduated cylinder sa patag na surface bago basahin ang volume, dahil ang paghawak nito ay maaaring tumagilid at magbigay ng maling sukat.
copy.bis: Ibutang ang graduated cylinder sa patag nga surface sa dili pa basahon ang volume, tungod kay ang paggunit niini mahimong motagilid ug mohatag ug sayop nga sukod.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Wood has flexibility, the ability to bend without breaking
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how the effects of earthquakes on communities depend on their magnitude
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a physical property of wood (flexibility) and its use in furniture making. It has no connection to earthquakes, their magnitude, or their effects on communities. The assigned competency is entirely unrelated to the card content.

copy.en: Wood has flexibility, the ability to bend without breaking, which is why thin strips of wood can be curved to make furniture like chairs.
copy.tl: Ang kahoy ay may flexibility, ang kakayahang yumuko nang hindi nababali, kaya ang manipis na piraso ng kahoy ay maaaring hubugin para makagawa ng muwebles tulad ng upuan.
copy.bis: Ang kahoy adunay flexibility, ang abilidad nga molubay nga dili mabali, mao nga ang nipis nga mga piraso sa kahoy mahimo kining kurbaon aron makahimo ug muwebles sama sa lingkuranan.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Floods bring too much water too quickly, which can drown plants, wash away soil, and destroy the homes of animals
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and diagrams the parts of the circulatory system as heart, blood, and blood vessels, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: Flood effects on ecosystems are unrelated to the circulatory system.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: drown plants, wash away soil, and destroy the homes of animals that live on land
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: Floods are not the five body systems.

copy.en:
How do floods change an ecosystem?

Floods bring too much water too quickly, which can drown plants, wash away soil, and destroy the homes of animals that live on land!
copy.tl:
Paano binabago ng baha ang isang ecosystem?

Ang baha ay nagdadala ng sobrang dami ng tubig nang napakabilis, na maaaring lumunod sa mga halaman, magtanggal ng lupa, at sumira sa mga tahanan ng mga hayop na nakatira sa lupa!
copy.bis:
Giunsa pag-usab sa baha ang usa ka ecosystem?

Ang baha nagdala ug sobra ka daghan nga tubig nga paspas kaayo, nga makalumos sa mga tanom, magkuha sa yuta, ug makaguba sa mga balay sa mga mananap nga nagpuyo sa yuta!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A phase change flowchart uses arrows
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of the solute and solvent in a solution
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a phase change flowchart (melting, evaporation) and contains no information about solutes, solvents, or solutions. It does not support the competency 'identify the role of the solute and solvent in a solution'.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A phase change flowchart uses arrows
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the Particle Model of Matter as 'All matter is made up of tiny particles with each pure substance having its own kind of particles.'
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about phase changes and does not mention the Particle Model of Matter, tiny particles, or pure substances. It does not support the competency 'describe the Particle Model of Matter'.

copy.en: A phase change flowchart uses arrows to show the direction matter changes, like solid to liquid for melting and liquid to gas for evaporation.
copy.tl: Ang phase change flowchart ay gumagamit ng mga arrow para ipakita ang direksyon ng pagbabago ng matter, tulad ng solid papuntang liquid para sa melting at liquid papuntang gas para sa evaporation.
copy.bis: Ang phase change flowchart mogamit og mga arrow aron ipakita ang direksyon sa pagbag-o sa matter, sama sa solid paingon sa liquid para sa melting ug liquid paingon sa gas para sa evaporation.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Some plants also have flowers and fruits, which add color to the plant and hold the seeds inside.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify and explain evidence that current continents are separate parts of what was a single continent millions of years ago
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses plant flowers and fruits, which is a biology topic. G9-E-1 requires identifying and explaining evidence for continental drift, an Earth science topic. There is no connection between the card content and the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Some plants also have flowers and fruits, which add color to the plant and hold the seeds inside.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the structures, movements and events that occur at each type of plate boundary
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about plant structures (flowers and fruits) and seed containment. G10-E-2 requires describing structures, movements, and events at plate boundaries, which is entirely unrelated to plant biology.

copy.en: Some plants also have flowers and fruits, which add color to the plant and hold the seeds inside.
copy.tl: May ilang halaman din na may bulaklak at prutas, na nagbibigay kulay sa halaman at naglalaman ng mga buto sa loob.
copy.bis: Ang uban nga mga tanom aduna usab mga bulak ug bunga, nga naghatag og kolor sa tanom ug nagasulod sa mga liso sa ilawom.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A fluorescent lamp changes electrical energy into light energy
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe the possible effects of human activities, such as deforestation, pollution, and introduction of invasive species, on living things in an ecosystem
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes energy conversion in a fluorescent lamp; it does not address human activities such as deforestation, pollution, or invasive species, nor their effects on living things in an ecosystem.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A fluorescent lamp changes electrical energy into light energy
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify issues and concerns in the local community and how they could be addressed by science, such as the treatment of waste
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about light and heat energy from a lamp, not about identifying local community issues/concerns or how science addresses them, such as waste treatment.

copy.en: A fluorescent lamp changes electrical energy into light energy to brighten a room, and it also produces some heat energy.
copy.tl: Ang fluorescent lamp ay nagpapalit ng electrical energy para maging light energy upang magliwanag ang silid, at gumagawa rin ito ng kaunting heat energy.
copy.bis: Ang fluorescent lamp nag-ilis sa electrical energy aron mahimong light energy aron modan-ag ang kwarto, ug naghimo usab kini og gamay nga heat energy.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: focal length of a concave mirror
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: Interpret PHIVOLCS Volcano Monitoring (Alert Levels) to demonstrate what to do before, during, and after a volcanic eruption
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches the focal length of a concave mirror, a physics/optics concept. G6-E-5 is about interpreting PHIVOLCS volcano alert levels and safety actions, which is entirely unrelated.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: focal length of a concave mirror
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the weather conditions according to a Public Storm Warning Signal issued by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geological and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA)
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about concave mirror focal length, not about weather conditions according to PAGASA Public Storm Warning Signals. No connection to the competency.

copy.en: The focal length of a concave mirror, the distance from its center to the focal point, is half of its radius of curvature.
copy.tl: Ang focal length ng concave mirror, ang distansya mula sa gitna nito hanggang sa focal point, ay kalahati ng radius of curvature nito.
copy.bis: Ang focal length sa concave mirror, ang distansya gikan sa tunga-tunga ngadto sa focal point, katunga sa iyang radius of curvature.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Folding bends an object into another shape, like turning a flat piece of paper into a paper airplane.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how high voltage electricity from power plants is generated and safely distributed to industries, businesses, and homes, including the role of substations (grid stations), and electric meters
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes folding solid materials into new shapes, a physical change topic. G10-F-9 requires describing high voltage electricity generation and safe distribution, including substations and electric meters. There is no connection between the card content and the competency.

copy.en: Folding bends an object into another shape, like turning a flat piece of paper into a paper airplane.
copy.tl: Ang pag-fold ay pagbebend ng isang bagay para maging ibang hugis, tulad ng paggawa ng flat na papel para maging paper airplane.
copy.bis: Ang pag-fold mao ang pagbend sa usa ka butang aron mahimong laing porma, sama sa paghimo sa flat nga papel aron mahimong paper airplane.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: estrogen causes the endometrium, the lining of the uterus, to thicken
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how the subduction of an oceanic plate impacts on the plate above it
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the menstrual cycle and estrogen's effect on the uterine lining, which is unrelated to subduction of oceanic plates.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: estrogen causes the endometrium, the lining of the uterus, to thicken
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the structures, movements and events that occur at each type of plate boundary
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the menstrual cycle and estrogen's effect on the uterine lining, which is unrelated to plate boundary structures, movements, or events.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The follicular phase happens from days 1 to 13
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the outer body parts of animals, such as head, legs or wings, and identify their role to move and to gather food
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the human menstrual cycle (follicular phase, estrogen, uterine lining), which is unrelated to observing and describing the outer body parts of animals and their roles in movement and feeding.

copy.en:
Why does the uterine lining thicken?

During the follicular phase, around days 8 to 11, estrogen causes the endometrium, the lining of the uterus, to thicken.
copy.tl:
Bakit kumakapal ang lining ng matris?

Sa follicular phase, mga araw 8 hanggang 11, ang estrogen ang nagpapakapal sa endometrium, ang lining ng matris.
copy.bis:
Ngano nga mibag-on ang lining sa matris?

Sa follicular phase, mga adlaw 8 hangtod 11, ang estrogen maoy nagpabag-on sa endometrium, ang lining sa matris.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Food availability affects reproduction and population size of consumers
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes of state for solids, liquids, and gases as melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation using diagrams and flowcharts
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses food availability, reproduction, and population size of consumers. It contains no content about changes of state (melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation) or diagrams/flowcharts of these processes.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Food availability affects reproduction and population size of consumers
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the role of heat energy in change of state processes
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about ecological relationships and reproduction, not about the role of heat energy in change of state processes. No relevant instructional support.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Food availability affects reproduction and population size of consumers
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how changes in temperature cause matter to change in state, such as solid to liquid to gas
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not describe how temperature changes cause matter to change state. It is unrelated to the competency's subject matter.

copy.en: Food availability affects reproduction and population size of consumers, because animals need enough food to survive, grow, and raise their young.
copy.tl: Ang sapat na pagkain ay nakakaapekto sa pagpaparami at laki ng population ng mga consumer, dahil kailangan ng mga hayop nito para mabuhay, lumaki, at mapalaki ang kanilang mga anak.
copy.bis: Ang igong pagkaon makaapekto sa pagpasanay ug gidak-on sa population sa mga consumer, tungod kay kinahanglan kini sa mga mananap aron mabuhi, motubo, ug mapadako ang ilang mga anak.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Food gives resistance - the body's ability to fight sickness - along with energy and nutrients that keep us strong and healthy
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the differences between animals with a backbone (vertebrates) and animals without backbones (invertebrates) by using common local examples of each group
assignedReviews.reason: Food and resistance to sickness are unrelated to animals with or without a backbone.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Food gives resistance - the body's ability to fight sickness
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the outer body parts of animals, such as head, legs or wings, and identify their role to move and to gather food
assignedReviews.reason: Food fighting sickness is not outer body parts such as head, legs or wings.

copy.en:
How does food help us fight sickness?

Food gives resistance - the body's ability to fight sickness - along with energy and nutrients that keep us strong and healthy.
copy.tl:
Paano tayo tinutulungan ng pagkain na labanan ang sakit?

Ang pagkain ay nagbibigay ng resistensya - ang kakayahan ng katawan na lumaban sa sakit - kasama ng lakas at sustansya na nagpapanatiling malakas at malusog sa atin.
copy.bis:
Giunsa kita pagtabang sa pagkaon sa pagbatok sa sakit?

Ang pagkaon naghatag og resistensya - ang abilidad sa lawas nga makigbatok sa sakit - uban sa kusog ug sustansya nga magpabiling lig-on ug himsog kanato.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: These hot foods and drinks warm the body from the inside
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain what volcanoes are and how they are formed
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains why people enjoy hot foods during the wet season, which is unrelated to volcanoes or their formation. It does not support any part of the competency 'explain what volcanoes are and how they are formed'.

copy.en:
Why do people like hot soup, coffee, and chocolate during the wet season?

These hot foods and drinks warm the body from the inside, which feels good when the rainy weather makes the air cold.
copy.tl:
Bakit gusto ng mga tao ang mainit na sopas, kape, at tsokolate tuwing wet season?

Ang mga maiinit na pagkain at inuming ito ay nagpapainit ng katawan mula sa loob, na masarap sa pakiramdam kapag pinalalamig ng ulan ang hangin.
copy.bis:
Ngano nga gusto sa mga tao ang init nga sabaw, kape, ug tsokolate panahon sa wet season?

Kining init nga mga pagkaon ug ilimnon magpainit sa lawas gikan sa sulud, nga lami sa pamati kung ang ulan makapabugnaw sa hangin.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A force is a push or a pull, and displacement is the shortest straight distance from the starting point to the final point.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the role of the water cycle in the environment
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines force and displacement, which are physics concepts. G5-E-6 requires explaining the role of the water cycle in the environment. There is no connection to the water cycle, evaporation, condensation, precipitation, or any earth/space content.

copy.en: A force is a push or a pull, and displacement is the shortest straight distance from the starting point to the final point.
copy.tl: Ang puwersa ay isang tulak o hila, at ang displacement ay ang pinakamaikling tuwid na distansya mula sa panimulang punto hanggang sa huling punto.
copy.bis: Ang puwersa usa ka tulod o bira, ug ang displacement mao ang pinakamubo nga tul-id nga distansya gikan sa sinugdanan nga punto hangtod sa katapusan nga punto.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Force is a vector quantity because it always has both magnitude
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the physical properties of solid materials, such as hard, shiny, or stretchable
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches that force is a vector quantity with magnitude and direction. This is a physics concept unrelated to describing physical properties of solid materials such as hard, shiny, or stretchable. The assigned competency is about matter properties, not forces.

copy.en: Force is a vector quantity because it always has both magnitude — how strong the push or pull is — and direction, like to the right or upward.
copy.tl: Ang force ay isang vector quantity dahil lagi itong may magnitude — kung gaano kalakas ang tulak o hatak — at direksyon, tulad ng pakanan o paitaas.
copy.bis: Ang force kay usa ka vector quantity tungod kay kanunay kini adunay magnitude — unsa kakusog ang tulod o bira — ug direksyon, sama sa patuo o paitaas.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A magnet exerts a force on a moving electric charge, and this magnetic force is always perpendicular to both the charge's velocity and the magnetic field.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Lorentz force on a moving charge is electromagnetism, not plant reproduction.

copy.en: A magnet exerts a force on a moving electric charge, and this magnetic force is always perpendicular to both the charge's velocity and the magnetic field.
copy.tl: Ang magnet ay gumagamit ng puwersa sa isang gumagalaw na electric charge, at ang magnetic force na ito ay laging perpendicular sa parehong velocity ng charge at sa magnetic field.
copy.bis: Ang magnet mogamit ug puwersa sa usa ka naglihok nga electric charge, ug kini nga magnetic force kanunay nga perpendicular sa velocity sa charge ug sa magnetic field.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Intermolecular interactions are the forces that exist between molecules, not the bonds inside a single molecule.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe different types of collisions as elastic or inelastic by providing some examples
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines intermolecular forces, a chemistry concept. G10-F-2 requires describing elastic and inelastic collisions with examples. The card provides no information about collisions, elasticity, or examples, so it does not support this competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Intermolecular interactions are the forces that exist between molecules, not the bonds inside a single molecule.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that momentum is conserved before and after the collision of objects
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses forces between molecules, not momentum or its conservation during collisions. G10-F-8 requires identifying that momentum is conserved before and after collisions. The card is unrelated to momentum or collisions.

copy.en: Intermolecular interactions are the forces that exist between molecules, not the bonds inside a single molecule.
copy.tl: Ang intermolecular interactions ay ang mga puwersang umiiral sa pagitan ng mga molecule, hindi ang mga bond sa loob ng isang molecule.
copy.bis: Ang intermolecular interactions mao ang mga puwersa nga naglungtad tali sa mga molecule, dili ang mga bond sa sulod sa usa ka molecule.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Intermolecular forces, the pulls between particles, are very strong in solids
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: make a Sun-Earth-Moon system model to demonstrate and explain the observable effects of predictable patterns and events including changes in seasons, changes observed in the patterns of visible star over a year, and solar and lunar eclipses
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses intermolecular forces in solids, a physics/chemistry topic. G6-E-8 requires making a Sun-Earth-Moon system model to explain seasons, star patterns, and eclipses. There is no connection to Earth-Sun-Moon motions or any astronomical content.

copy.en: Intermolecular forces, the pulls between particles, are very strong in solids, holding the particles tightly together.
copy.tl: Ang intermolecular forces, ang hatakan sa pagitan ng mga particle, ay napakalakas sa solid, kaya mahigpit na magkakadikit ang mga particle.
copy.bis: Ang intermolecular forces, ang pagbira tali sa mga particle, kusog kaayo sa solid, mao nga hugot nga nagkupot ang mga particle.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A book resting on a table has two main forces: gravity pulling it down and the table pushing it up, and these forces are equal and opposite.

copy.en: A book resting on a table has two main forces: gravity pulling it down and the table pushing it up, and these forces are equal and opposite.
copy.tl: Ang isang aklat na nakapatong sa mesa ay may dalawang pangunahing force: ang gravity na humihila dito pababa at ang mesa na tumutulak dito pataas, at ang mga force na ito ay magkapantay at magkasalungat.
copy.bis: Ang usa ka libro nga nagpahulay sa lamesa adunay duha ka pangunang force: ang gravity nga mobira kini paubos ug ang lamesa nga motulak kini paitaas, ug kini nga mga force parehas ug magkaatbang.
